findings.title: "Leftovers are already wrapped" holds only when the earlier cast passed the hidden-trait check
findings.detail: Entries left in preCastActions by a Notify_StartedCasting call where GetTitan returned null or HasHiddenTraitGranting was false were never wrapped. Starting at __state skips them on the next cast. That's harmless as long as a trait never goes from discovered back to undiscovered, and as long as a titan never gains a hidden trait for an ability while a cancelled cast's entries are still in the list. Consider rewording the comment to say this rather than claiming every leftover is wrapped. Not checked: whether anything can set discovered back to false.

findings.title: No corpus precedent for this target
findings.detail: None of the 15 scanned mod trees patches Ability.Notify_StartedCasting, so the corpus can't tell us whether a prefix plus postfix is the usual approach. A void prefix that only reads the list is the least intrusive way to patch it.
